cadence: First Tuesday of every month, 12:30pm AEST

sessions.title: AI for accounting practices: the first three things to automate
sessions.blurb: The three tasks in a practice that pay back fastest, and the two that look tempting and aren't. Built for practices under twenty people.
covers: Chasing outstanding records without writing the email each time
Turning a tax position into something a client will actually read
Where the client-data line sits, and which tools stay on the right side of it

sessions.title: AI and patient privacy: what a practice can and can't use
sessions.blurb: The clearest version of the line we can give you: which tasks are safe, which are not, and what has to be true before anything touches patient information.
covers: Why consumer AI tools are not an option for identifiable patient data
The administrative tasks that are safe to start with this week
What a practice AI policy needs to say to be worth having

sessions.title: AI for NDIS providers: less time writing notes, without cutting corners
sessions.blurb: Documentation is most of the job. This session is about compressing the writing while keeping the record accurate, contemporaneous and attributable to the worker.
covers: Shift notes into proper progress notes, on the day
Incident reports drafted without facing an empty form after a hard shift
Where participant privacy and audit defensibility actually bite

sessions.title: AI for real estate: listings, follow-up and vendor reports
sessions.blurb: The writing load in an agency is relentless and repetitive, which is the easiest kind to compress. Sales and property management both.
covers: Listing copy that sounds like your agency, not like a portal
Buyer follow-up that doesn't read automated
The review step that keeps generated copy out of underquoting trouble

sessions.title: AI on site: turning voice notes into variations and RFIs
sessions.blurb: For people who are not at a desk. Everything in this session starts from a voice note or three lines typed with one thumb.
covers: The variation written up the same day instead of never
Finding the clause in a 200-page spec in under a minute
Why the numbers stay yours and the words don't have to

sessions.title: AI in legal practice: drafting safely, and the citation trap
sessions.blurb: Starting with the failure the profession has already read about, then the drafting and summarising work where these tools genuinely earn their place.
covers: Why AI invents case citations, and the verification discipline that stops it
Chronologies, file notes and client updates — the safe, high-volume wins
Confidentiality and privilege: what must never be pasted in
